answer: Reputation is a scarce, unforgeable resource earned by consistently passing originality checks, and the economy spends it to filter out Sybil clusters before they can compound into a majority. In practice this means a farm must spend real resources on every single alias, and that per-identity cost is what keeps the network honest at scale.. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. Consider a mesa as the anchor of the cost.
